To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mutual recognition between the nucleic acid components of oligonucleotides allows the regulation of the activity of the conjugate molecules.

the mutual recognition between nucleotide segments of nucleic acid hybrids can be used to constrain the distance between the peptide and protein segments and thus control the affinity and activity of these bioconjuates for protein targets.
the mutual recognition between nucleotides allows the design of oligonucleotides-peptides conjugates with a high degree of control of their activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of oligonucleotides to control protein activity and to regulate protein-protein interaction.
the development of smart oligonucloetide-peptide hybrids that allow the regulation of the functional properties of peptides and proteins.
the development of novel oligonucleotide-protein hybrids that allow the regulation of the function of the conjugate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
nucleic acid-proteins hybrids are versatile and useful tools in the development of novel bioactive molecules.
the oligonucleotides have the ability to control the structure of the peptide segment, the structure of the protein segment or the distance between the two segments.
smart oligonucleic acid-peptide hybrids have the potential to control the activity of peptide and protein ligands in a spatially addressable manner.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
smart oligonucleotides have been successfully applied to control peptide and protein activity.
smart oligonucleotides have the potential to regulate the activity of peptide and protein segments.
the mutual recognition of oligonucleotides is a versatile tool to regulate the activity of peptides or proteins.
The main takeaway from our work is that
smart oligonucleotides can be used to regulate the functional properties of peptide and protein ligands.
smart oligonucleotides are versatile tools to control the function of peptides and proteins.
the mutual recognition between nucleotide segments can be used to control the structure and thus the function of peptide and protein ligands.
